name: Andorra Family Dentistry
description: Dr. Shah, Dr. Emani, and Dr. Bansal take care of kids, parents, and grandparents in one office. Call when you want a cleaning, a repair, or a calmer first visit.

hero.headline: Family dentistry on Ridge Avenue
hero.sub: Dr. Shah, Dr. Emani, and Dr. Bansal take care of kids, parents, and grandparents in one office. Call when you want a cleaning, a repair, or a calmer first visit.

story.heading: A practice that knows your name
paragraphs: Our team focuses on comfortable visits and a full range of care, from a first cleaning to implants and Invisalign. People come from Andorra, Conshohocken, Lafayette Hill, and Roxborough.
You will see digital scans, clear explanations, and a plan you can follow. Bring the whole family. We will make room.

items: See the room before you sit
Talk to a person, not a form
experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: A smile you will actually show
feature.text: Cosmetic work here is practical: bonding, veneers, whitening, and clear aligners when they fit. We start with what you want to change, then pick the smallest step that gets you there.

spotlight.heading: Close to home in Andorra
spotlight.text: The office sits at 8919 Ridge Avenue. Park, walk in, and tell us what is bothering you. We will tell you what we can do today.

contact.heading: Come see us on Ridge Avenue
contact.sub: Phone and address are on this page so you can act without hunting. Confirm hours on the official site before you drive.
